source.title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Feral Edition
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy ViolenceGamesWarrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Feral EditionReleases 10/23/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Feral EditionFantasy ViolenceLoadingView DLCForge your destiny, defend your Clan, and live the life of a true Warrior Cat.Sharpen your claws and your look. Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is an immersive action-adventure game set in the Lake Territories of the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Embark on a variety of quests to gain favor with your Clan and battle others in turn-based combat to strengthen your cat and grow your legend. Learn new combat moves to take down your rivals. Encounter a wide range of enemies, including mice, squirrels, badgers and more, all leading to epic battles. Forage the land and find materials that can be used to craft items in your den. Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Your adventure will also take you to the famed sacred locations The Moonpool and The Island. Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of StarClan itself.AN ORIGINAL STORYEmbark on a brand-new journey with iconic cats and locations from the Warrior Cats franchise. CREATE YOUR OWN WARRIOR CATUsing the robust cat creator, name and create your very own Warrior Cat. The Feral Edition includes The Prophecy Pack:The Prophecy Pack includes:• 8 Accessories to use in the cat creator • 12 Wearable accessories • Cel-shaded characters skin• 4 cat poses poses for photo mode• 4 photo mode effectsGAME FEATURES:* 3 Game types: Prophecy Mode, Defender Mode, Skirmish Mode.Prophecy Mode - Four original stories about the trials and tribulations of Clan life. Defender mode - Test how long you can last while battling all of the game’s fiercest enemies in a single run.Skirmish mode - Battle other players online asynchronously.* Create your own unique Warrior Cat with millions of possible customization combinations.* 6 iconic locations from the book series: ThunderClan territory, RiverClan territory, ShadowClan territory, WindClan territory, The Moonpool and The Island.* Turn-based combat system with up to 3 versus 3 battles. * 75 unique combat moves to discover and unlock.* Interact with 9 cats from the beloved book series.* Battle a large variety of enemies including badgers, vicious foxes, imposing Dobermanns, rival Clan cats and many more. * Track and hunt birds, rabbits, squirrels and other prey.* Visit your friend's camp online asynchronously. * You can also help friends with by crafting items or gifting them necessary resources and materials.* No two playthroughs are the same as characters, quests and stories are procedurally generated.Software description provided by the publisher.Bundle includes the following:For details on the products in this bundle, including up-to-date system compatibility information, please refer to each product page listed below.Warrior Cats: Clans of the ForestGamesWarrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Prophecy PackGamesPublisher notification(s):Purchases made by 10/23/2026 00:00 PDT will receive the following bonus: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - The Purrfect Look Pack.Put your best paws forward with the Purrfect Look Pack. Create a fierce look with the cat creator with four unique elements that are only available by preordering.Related tagsRole playingCharacter customizationRaise your statsShow moreAbout this itemSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. All users should read the Health and Safety Information available in the system settings before using this software.It's possible that information related to the game, including ratings and download size, may not be finalized at time of preorder.
